title: Synthetic hold: the true price of any betting market
instructions: Read as a knowledgeable, friendly sports analyst explaining a simple idea to an adult beginner. Natural American English, clear and brisk, about 165 words per minute. Warm, conversational, understated. No hype, no shouting, no added words. Keep the same voice and pace throughout. Pronounce arb as the single word arb.

scenes.label: THE PRICE OF A BET
scenes.headline:
Every book
charges a fee.
scenes.narration: Every sportsbook charges a fee to bet. At minus one ten on both sides, that fee is a four point five five percent hold. But you don't have to pay any one book's price.

scenes.label: ONE BOOK AT A TIME
scenes.headline:
Three books.
Three prices.
scenes.narration: Here are three books pricing the same Bills minus three spread. On its own, each one holds about four and a half percent.

scenes.label: BUILD THE SYNTHETIC MARKET
scenes.headline:
Best price.
Each side.
scenes.detail: Bills at Book B • Dolphins at Book A
scenes.narration: Now take the best price on each side, wherever it sits. Bills minus one oh eight at Book B. Dolphins minus one oh five at Book A. That pairing is the synthetic market.

scenes.label: DO THE MATH
scenes.headline:
51.92%
+ 51.22%
scenes.narration: Those prices imply fifty-one point nine two and fifty-one point two two percent. Together, a hundred three point one four. That's a synthetic hold of three point oh five percent. About a third cheaper, for the exact same bet.

scenes.label: FAIR ODDS
scenes.headline:
Strip out
the margin.
scenes.narration: Divide each side by the total, and the fair odds come out near fifty point three and forty-nine point seven percent. Built from the sharpest number on each side, not one book's opinion.

scenes.label: A REAL BOARD
scenes.headline:
Eagles–Bears
total 41.5
scenes.narration: It happens in real markets. On Monday's Eagles–Bears total, ten books held between three and a quarter and four and three quarter percent. The synthetic market held three point oh four. Lower than every single book.

scenes.label: BELOW ZERO
scenes.headline:
Under 100%?
That's an arb.
scenes.detail: Rare • fast • often a stale quote
scenes.narration: If the best prices add up to less than a hundred percent, the synthetic hold goes negative. That's an arb. It's rare, it moves fast, and it's often just a stale quote. Books can also limit accounts that bet them.

scenes.label: WHY IT MATTERS
scenes.headline:
Same opinion.
Different price.
scenes.narration: The real payoff is on every bet. If you think the Bills cover fifty-three percent of the time, minus one oh eight earns about two dollars per hundred. At minus one fifteen, the same opinion loses almost a dollar.

scenes.label: BETTING BASICS / 02
scenes.headline:
Price the market,
not the book.
scenes.detail: Try the Synthetic Hold Calculator under Tools
scenes.narration: Read the market as a whole, and take the best price on each side. Try the synthetic hold calculator at fourth and value dot com.
